chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Louis, Zutty and the choice between friendship and business
summary: Louis asked Zutty to stay with him, but Zutty had a Connie's Inn offer and told Louis friendship is one thing and business another; Mezz's book says he cut out from Louis.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: That's why when they wanted me to stay in Connie's Inn all the show girls, all the chorus girls, see, and the principals also, they wanted me to stay. And that's when Louis and Marge and I went to Louis' home and Lille was there and I asked Louis did he want me to stay with him? Because if not, I've got a job to stay in Connie's Inn. See?

Yes. Oh way after, yes. And so Louis told me how much money he had a chance to make and everything like that. And that's when I told Louis, I said, well Louis, friendship is one thing and business is another. See, but Mezz put it in his book that I was cutting out from Louis. But Marge knows that I'm speaking the truth.

I didn't want you to even go see him. Because I told Zutty, I said Louis wanted you. But getting back to Audubon. Now you dropped, you drifted from there. You didn't tell about that audition for the Ziegfield show.
